name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen "Not So Little Chicken Sandwich" (Slaw on Side Mod)
whyItWorks: Enormous crispy fried chicken cutlet on a comically small mini brioche bun with sweet teriyaki glaze. White meat chicken breast is lean and digestible.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Not So Little Chicken Sandwich with sweet teriyaki glaze; ask for the raw red cabbage slaw served on the side.
watchOuts: Keep raw cabbage slaw on the side to prevent roughage gas
